evidence.title: 神心妙达 at 淳化轩
evidence.summary: In 1814 the 乐奏钧天 stage and dressing rooms went up on the east of 淳化轩, and 神心妙达 was rebuilt as the hall to watch from. The same words in S05 j81:35b are a quotation in the 水木明瑟 preface and have nothing to do with this hall.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 含经堂
evidence.summary: The largest group in this garden, finished 1747, rebuilt 1770 with 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼. 含经堂 is a seven-bay double-eaved glazed hall; 霞翥楼 mirrors 梵香楼 and, with the inner plaque 味腴书室, held the 四库全书荟要, which identifies our 味腴书屋. A stage was added east of 淳化轩 in 1814. Guards were still posted after 1860.

evidence.title: 含经堂 乐奏钧天 stage as cited in 圆明园戏场探微
evidence.summary: The park's theatre paper reports the excavated 乐奏钧天 Yuezou Juntian stage of 含经堂 as about 16 m square, built over a granite cellar with a clear height of 2.47 m.
